Other items: All marked answers are correct, with exactly one right choice for each tap item. The keypad answers (5, 2, 3, 6, 2, 3, 3) and the number-line answers (2, 3, 3) are correct. Tap-6 asks how many friends, and 9 ÷ 3 = 3 friends is right.
